title: Azure Waste Finder report
description: Output of `waste-finder --format json` (report.json). Amounts are monthly, in `currency`, list prices with 730 h per month.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR. Minor bumps add optional fields; major bumps rename or remove fields.

scope.description: What was scanned, e.g. `subscription 1234…` or `all subscriptions`.

demo.description: True for `--demo` runs on built-in fake data.

monthly_savings.description: Sum of `monthly_savings` over all findings (unpriced count as 0).

unpriced.description: Findings without a price, not part of the total.

ignored.description: Resources skipped by the ignore tag or an exclude pattern; not in `findings`.

below_threshold.description: Findings saving less than `min_monthly_savings`; not in `findings`.

cleanup.description: Free clean-up findings (cost 0), listed in `cleanup`, not part of the total. Since 1.3.

Free clean-up findings (priced at 0, severity `info`), e.g. orphaned NICs, unattached NSGs, empty resource groups. Not part of `summary.monthly_savings` and not subject to `min_monthly_savings`. Sorted by subscription, resource group, rule, name. Since 1.3.

rule.description: Rule id from the registry, e.g. `stopped_vm`.

subscription_id.description: Parsed from `resource_id`; empty if it has none.

age_days.description: Age in days for age-based rules (e.g. days since a snapshot was created), else null. Since 1.1.

quantity.description: Billed units where the price depends on them (e.g. App Service plan instances), else null. Since 1.2.

monthly_cost.description: What the resource costs now; null if no price was found.

monthly_savings.description: What acting on the finding saves; equals `monthly_cost` unless the action is a downgrade.

price_note.description: How the price was derived, e.g. `0.0112 €/h × 730 h`.

command.description: The `az` command that fixes it. The tool never runs it.
